Integration Engineer - Marketplace (contract)

Company: VendorBridge

We connect 200+ vendor APIs to our marketplace and need a contractor to build and harden the integration layer.

- Python, webhooks, REST, message queues (RabbitMQ/Kafka)
- Idempotent ingestion, retries, dead-letter handling
- Build the new Shopify + Amazon SP-API integrations

Contract: B2B, 20-30 h/week, $2,500 - $3,500 per month
Remote: worldwide, 4h overlap with UTC
AI tools: allowed. Subcontracting: allowed with disclosure. No exclusivity.
Application: write to engineering@vendorbridge.example
notes: C archetype: webhook/integration focus maps to exp.acme.b1 (event-driven pipeline) and exp.globex.b2 (rollout process).
